officialLinks.label: Grade values; GPA formula; special grades

helpIntro: Michigan Tech uses a 4.0 scale with half-step grades: A=4.0, AB=3.5, B=3.0, BC=2.5, C=2.0, CD=1.5, D=1.0, and F/X=0. Enter grade-point credits and final grades to estimate your GPA.
helpNote: Transfer grades do not enter Michigan Tech GPA. For ordinary eligible repeats, the most recent final grade replaces the earlier grade even if it is lower. The shared calculator displays three decimals; Michigan Tech states that its GPA is truncated, so your official transcript controls.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points and a 4-credit AB earns 14. Together, 26 ÷ 7 ≈ 3.714 in this planning display.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00; credits still count as grade point hours.
gradeExplanations.F*: Academic-dishonesty failure; 0.00 points. Repeat eligibility needs official review.
gradeExplanations.X: Conditional X is computed as F until resolved; it can later change to the earned grade.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded while pending; if unresolved by the deadline it converts to F. At graduation an I is treated as F.
gradeExplanations.IS: In-session temporary grade; excluded until a final grade posts.
gradeExplanations.N: No grade/no credit; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.CR: Credit by examination/advanced placement; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Pass/fail satisfactory; credit but no grade points and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.E: Pass/fail effort unsatisfactory; no credit or grade points and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.E*: Pass/fail effort unsatisfactory due to academic dishonesty; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U*: Unsatisfactory audit due to academic dishonesty; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.SCV: COVID-19 satisfactory pass grade; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.LCV: COVID-19 satisfactory-low pass grade; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.ECV: COVID-19 effort-unsatisfactory grade; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Michigan Tech course
specialTypes.note: Use posted Michigan Tech grade and credits.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades and transfer GPAs do not enter University or departmental GPA.

specialTypes.name: Academic Renewal coursework
specialTypes.note: Use only after Academic Renewal is officially granted; renewed terms are excluded from University GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: For an ordinary eligible repeat with the same credits and final letter grades, the most recent grade replaces the earlier grade in GPA. Confirm waivers, third attempts, similar repeats, and repeatable-for-credit courses with your advisor/Registrar.
